question:
**Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

At all costs

options.text: Whatever is needed to achieve something

solution:
Here, the correct answer is **"Whatever is needed to achieve something."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The phrase **"at all costs"** is an idiomatic expression that means to do something regardless of the difficulties, risks, or sacrifices involved. (कठिनाइयों, जोखिमों या बलिदानों की परवाह किए बिना कुछ करना)
 
• It emphasizes a strong commitment to achieving a goal or avoiding a particular outcome, even if it requires significant effort or resources. 
 
 
• **Example**: *He was determined to succeed **at all costs**__, even if it meant working long hours and facing numerous challenges.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
